content.bio: I'm a fullstack developer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Since July 2026 I've been a frontend developer at Reclee LLC, where I moved the internal interface and the landing pages onto a design system built on shadcn/ui and ReUI. Before that, from May 2023 to April 2024, I was a fullstack developer at Pawtrics Software LLC, building React components with Next.js and a CRUD system on Supabase and PostgreSQL.
content.details: I work on Fedora Linux and study Programming and Software Development at Universidad Tecnológica Nacional. Outside of work I maintain NachUI, an open source component system of 37 components with its own CLI and a NestJS registry API, and I build AI assistants with Python, FastAPI, and Google Gemini.

items.question: Who is Ignacio Figueroa?
items.answer: I'm Ignacio Figueroa, a fullstack developer from Buenos Aires, Argentina. I've been a frontend developer at Reclee LLC since July 2026, and before that I was a fullstack developer at Pawtrics Software LLC between May 2023 and April 2024. I'm also the author of NachUI, an open source component system.

items.question: What tech stack does Ignacio Figueroa use?
items.answer: Day to day I write TypeScript with React, Next.js, and Node.js on the frontend, and Python with FastAPI or NestJS on the backend, with PostgreSQL for persistence. I style with Tailwind CSS and develop on Fedora Linux. For AI work I use Google Gemini, the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and Groq.

items.question: What is NachUI?
items.answer: NachUI is the open source component system I build, published at nachui.tech. It ships 37 accessible React primitives that you copy into your project as source code instead of installing as a dependency. The monorepo also holds a CLI that injects components and OKLCH design tokens, a NestJS registry API, and an AI agent that answers questions from the real source code.

items.question: Is Ignacio Figueroa available for work?
items.answer: Yes — I'm open to fullstack and AI integration roles, on contract or full-time, working remotely from Buenos Aires. The fastest way to reach me is contact@ignaciofigueroa.dev, and the contact form on this site sends me a direct email.

items.question: Where does Ignacio Figueroa live and what timezone is he in?
items.answer: I live in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in the UTC−3 timezone. That overlaps with most of the United States business day and with European mornings, and I work remotely.

items.question: What languages does Ignacio Figueroa work in?
items.answer: Spanish is my first language and I work professionally in English. The documentation, code, and commit messages I write are in English, and this site is published in both languages — you're reading the English version.

items.question: What has Ignacio Figueroa built with AI?
items.answer: I built Nacho Assistant, a retrieval-augmented assistant on FastAPI, LangChain, and Google Gemini that answers questions about my work using vector search over my own content. I also built NachUI Support AI, a tool-calling agent that reads the real NachUI source code at query time, and Services AI Assistant, a Gemini 2.5 Flash agent that collects contact requests through autonomous function calling.

items.question: What did Ignacio Figueroa study?
items.answer: I'm studying for an Associate Degree in Programming and Software Development at Universidad Tecnológica Nacional in Argentina, which I started in March 2025. I've been learning software development on my own since March 2022, and I hold certifications from Anthropic (Claude 101) and Google.
